description.value:
You and your environment naturally cycle magic through each other. You can cast the Detect Magic cantrip as an innate Arcane spell. Cantrips are automatically heightened to a rank equal to half your level, rounded down.

If you remain in a locale’s general vicinity (approximately up to a few miles) for a day, you get a strong sense of the kinds of magic that inhibits it; this grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Identify, Recall or otherwise find sources of magic that are tied to the environment in some way. The magic could come from a powerful individual, a creature, a spirit, or some magical item, or even be a natural wellspring or source of it, or some man-made imprint that has strongly influenced the land. This benefit remains until you move to another locale for a day.
